memory.method: Windows .NET process counters for the isolated browser and descendants; snapshots at workflow phases.

snapshots.phase: 3D plus loaded compact model and actual inference

limitations: Working-set sums can count shared physical pages more than once.
Summed per-process lifetime peaks are not a simultaneous browser peak.
Subprocesses that start and exit entirely between snapshots can be missed; this is not an exact full-session peak.
These are desktop headless measurements, not real mobile hardware or a memory guarantee.

samples.phase: 3D plus loaded compact model and actual inference

gpu.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti (0x00002D04) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-32.0.16.2124)

limitations: Headless desktop Chrome at desktop and phone-sized viewports; no real phone hardware.
Cold isolated profile; open-to-data includes actual NASA grid retrieval and renderer load, not a stable network-independent guarantee.
Memory samples are process-tree working sets, not exact simultaneous full-session peaks.
Field boundary path excluded because the live Overpass release gate is unavailable; no field was substituted.
preserveDrawingBuffer is enabled in this application for screenshot verification.
